# Williams Olayemi Martins

> Nigerian Visual (Creative) Director, brand designer and frontend developer based in Lagos. Seven+ years shaping identities, digital products and marketing systems for African startups and global brands; ships lightweight browser-based tools on the side.

Also known as: Yẹmí, Williams Martins, Olayemi Martins, willomarty.

## About
- Full name: Williams Olayemi Martins (Olayemi is a middle name).
- Location: Lagos, Nigeria — available worldwide, remote-first.
- Role: Visual (Creative) Director spanning brand identity, UI/UX, video production, copywriting and frontend engineering.
- Contact: willomarty01@gmail.com · +234 702 678 7353

## Services
- Brand identity and logo systems
- UI/UX design for web and mobile products
- Frontend development with React, TypeScript and Tailwind
- Video production, editing and motion design
- Creative direction for marketing and product campaigns
- AI-assisted product development (Lovable, Orchids/Buds, Claude, ChatGPT, GitHub Copilot, Gemini)

## Micro-tools shipped
- [Scrapely](https://scrapely-ai.vercel.app/): Turn any webpage into clean JSON with AI-assisted extraction.
- [Screenshot Studio](https://screen-shot-studio.vercel.app/): Device-framed screenshots of any URL for design reviews.
- [ImageSqueeze](https://image-squeeze-lite.vercel.app/): Privacy-first, in-browser JPEG/PNG/WebP compression.
- [Pocket QR](https://pocket-qr-vision.vercel.app/): Generate and scan QR codes from the browser, no install.

## Selected client work
- Vana: Logo, packaging and marketing for an all-natural Nigerian feminine cosmetic brand.
- Frauwa Roofs & Interior Decor: Visual identity and promo reel for a Lagos roofing and interior firm.
- Zamack Consults: Brand refresh and minimalist logo system.
- Moon Republic: Educational and promotional marketing design for a Web3 learning platform.
- Activate Pilot: Brand identity for an AI-powered business naming service.
- Juliet Moses: Monogram, tags and stationery for a Nigerian fashion label.
- Rebound: Self-initiated identity concept for a fictional herbal energy drink.
- Mytherapist.ng: Editorial marketing design and educational video for a Nigerian mental-health firm.
- Getcrib: Marketing and app-feature demos for a Nigerian rental startup.
- Incash: Web app, mobile app and marketing site for an employee-focused fintech.
- Zaytrix Modeste: Shopify storefront for a Canadian modest-fashion retailer.
- Caretaker Pro Inc.: Website and property-management software for a Nigerian real-estate firm.
- Zaytrix Mgmt. & Tech Group: Corporate site for a Canadian telecom and tech group.
- #EndSARS Documentary: Video documentary on the #EndSARS movement, inspired by Aisha Yesufu.
